cells.gaps: No share or count of primary schools entering attendance or results: the 92.7% (4,322 of 4,662 public primary establishments, December 2023) is not said to be schools entering data, and the same deck puts the uploading of primary pupils' absences at 2%, of what it does not say. The newer facts (2025, 2026) describe enrolment only and disagree with `routine`, and the 2026 platform names no level; the strategy behind plan:current is unnamed and gives no period, finance is not stated, and the last twelve months hold both a launch and a boycott call over failures (TUN-014).
cells.note: Madrassati is the ministry's primary-stage system in service beyond a pilot, with absences uploaded at a low rate, and first-year pupils are registered nationally under a unique identifier, which meets stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half of primary schools entering attendance or results, and the only share held is of establishments on the system, which places by the lower rung.
